effects.result: pay caster HP once per effect/root at resolve then emit ordinary physical/magical damage; never self-kill or refund SP; no incoming-damage proc

handler_registry.contract: select matching status instances on target with same source actor; select expiry then application_id up to max_consumed; consume exactly selected instances; emit flat raw power=count*power_per_instance through normal damage pipeline; snapshot consumed count once; cannot consume unrelated poison

modifier_source: runtime attaches immutable source_instance_id; definitions cannot choose another owner source

proc_guard.limit_reached: diagnostic failure, never silently truncate buff stacks

snapshot: caster offense and pre-cost resources at cast start; status carries application offense snapshot; defense live per hit
special_effect_lifecycle: shield independent pools; summoned actors not roster members and do not prevent party defeat; revive restarts next unspent SI, no refund or replay of spent slot

special_contracts_d169.selector: highest max(P.ATK,M.ATK), optional exclude_self/actor_kind; actor_id ties
special_contracts_d169.parameter_formulas: registry-only nonnegative snapshot raw power to declared numeric status params; no JS evaluation
special_contracts_d169.damage_charge: oldest eligible charge per resolved damaging skill, whole root action; normals/periodic/proc do not consume
special_contracts_d169.skill_echo: descending tier conditional roll once per instance/root; add extra repeat counts between independent applications; Bolt whitelist only
special_contracts_d169.magic_critical: optional cast and periodic status snapshot flag, absent false
special_contracts_d169.visual_link: presentation color from live status source to recipient
